I have kept this small plot of enset and coffee for many years, and it feeds my family well enough without costly chemicals. I will spread manure from my oxen on it, as I do every season, but I will save the DAP and urea I receive from the cooperative for my maize and teff fields where it matters more. These are old plants, so I do not need new seed, and we do not spray pesticides on our food crops. My wife and children can manage the weeding and harvesting on this small piece of land ourselves, so I will not hire any workers.
